sourceCoverage.rationale: The article discloses eighty-six regularly spaced visual samples and four ending checks, with gaps, uninspected audio and absent transcript stated prominently.

supportingArgument.rationale: The piece explains why visual coordination and shared purpose are different propositions, while acknowledging the work as an intentionally composed film.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Observed frames, creator production claims, author-deposited mathematics, separate studies and proposed GhostMesh tests are named as different evidence roles.

counterargument.rationale: The strongest counterpoint is that a film is an artwork, so it need not prove a deployed protocol; the critique applies when operational conclusions are borrowed from it.

tradeoffs.rationale: A sparse visual inspection supports responsible descriptive writing and a private media boundary, but it sacrifices continuous trajectory and sound analysis.

falsifiability.rationale: A pinned code and render trace, controlled membership and delay tests, and a consented film-specific perception study would separate model, image and response.

originalSynthesis.rationale: The GhostMesh synthesis is that agreement is a state update rule while collective purpose is an interpretation shaped by production and viewing conditions.

performance.rationale: The article makes no throughput or efficiency recommendation; its technical concern is semantic and control correctness under specified state transitions.

economics.rationale: No price, market or operating-cost claim is evaluated for this audiovisual artwork; no economic recommendation follows from the frames.

threatGovernance.rationale: The piece names membership, message delay, lost effects and recovery boundaries before translating a simulated trajectory into an operational claim.

gaps.rationale: An actual independent qualitative source, mathematics, visual-fidelity and privacy review is required before owner acceptance or release.
The source-specific visual-only exception leaves audio and intervals between sampled frames unobserved; the article states those limits instead of filling them in.
Creator assertions about agent count, production tools and soundtrack timing remain unverified pending project-source or qualified audio evidence.

decisionRationale: Hold this source-grounded draft as a preview candidate until an independent reviewer challenges the article and Tony decides whether its exact content is acceptable.
